admission.justification: A symlinked intermediate path would let a store act read or delete outside the admitted task area.

applicability: Every frame store act on a task-confined frame area.
conditions: The path resolves through one or more intermediate components under the task.
exclusions: Another task's area or an admitted working folder.

evidence: A4-checks/probes.json: intermediate-manifest-read-before-guard; focused F11 sibling/dry-run cases

statement: All frame writes, reads and reclamation must remain physically inside the admitted task/frame scope even when an intermediate frame path is a symlink.
